metadata.description: Tanner O'Rourke's plugin index. Each entry is its own repository; this manifest only points at them.

plugins.name: pnw-outdoor-planner
plugins.description: Researches a Pacific Northwest outdoor trip across six factor agents and returns a sourced go/no-go verdict, with weather and avalanche skills usable on their own.

plugins.name: shopping-research
plugins.description: Product search, cross-retailer prices, Amazon price history, and community deals over free sources, with self-reported coverage on every call.

plugins.name: executor
plugins.description: Runs a written plan as contracted checkpoints: briefs a delegate agent for each one, gates the result with the checkpoint's own acceptance commands, and writes a trace of the run at close.

plugins.name: roster
plugins.description: Practice packs a session or a delegate reads before it works: the experience rules every project passes, a design procedure with rules for five media, and four review lenses, routed by one skill.
